title: 蘑菇收藏盒
subject: a small open rounded warm-brown wooden collecting box containing two small mushrooms, one slightly taller coral-red mushroom and a smaller honey-gold mushroom, both with cream stems and simple broad caps. One tiny sage-green leaf tucked against the box. Simplify the box to a single chunky tray, no lid, no woodgrain, no faces
